settings.title: Premier Athletic Flooring
settings.text:
Our commitment extends to delivering top-notch sports tile solutions to residential and commercial needs.

Experience unparalleled performance, safety, durability, and reliability with our premium athletic sports flooring, all while maintaining stylish flair.

settings.title: Interlocking
settings.text: No drying time for adhesives or professional tools required. Simply snap together the multi-patented tiles and your custom court will be ready to use in no time!

settings.title: Customizable
settings.text: Personalize your space with our customizable options, available in 7 vibrant colors. Tailor the design to your preferences, offering limitless configuration possibilities and unique aesthetics.

settings.title: Shock-absorbent Surface
settings.text: When interlocked, these tiles create a superior shock-absorbent surface, offering a 10-15% softer feel than concrete. This design enhances player comfort and reduces strain during gameplay.

settings.title: how it works
settings.text:
We do all the heavy lifting for you so you only need a couple of snaps to set the sports tiles and its ready to go!

After preparing a firm and stable subsurface, you can begin installing your DIY court tiles.

The pre-assemble kits comes with markings and also includes edging.

*Basketball hoop is not included

settings.title: Add the Perfect Hoop
settings.text: With advanced features like adjustable height and a tempered glass backboard, this hoop is built for those who want to play hard and play smart.

settings.title: DIY COURT INSTALLATION
settings.text: You don't need to be an expert to install your new Outdoor Basketball or Multi-Game Court. Our DIY court installation is designed for simplicity and efficiency. Without the need for adhesives or complex tools, you can set up your court quickly and easily.

settings.title: Concrete Base Specifications
settings.text:
Outdoor sports surfaces deliver optimal performance when installed on hard, flat, and stable subsurfaces such as concrete, asphalt, or a properly compacted base.

To better guide you on your DIY project, download specifications for more details.

settings.title: Complete Your Outdoor Court
settings.text: Refine the look of your outdoor sports court with our Outdoor Sport Tile Edging. These edges effortlessly snap into place, providing a neat, beveled border for a polished finish.
